subfiles.about: Claude A. Buss requests John Allison's assistance in overcoming an administrative delay holding up an exit permit for visiting professor Kazuo Kawai.
subfiles.summary: Buss asks Allison to speed Kazuo Kawai's exit permit for Stanford.

subfiles.about: John M. Allison informs Claude A. Buss that clearance for Kazuo Kawai was telegraphed to Japan on July 11, allowing him to sail on time.
subfiles.summary: Allison tells Buss that Kawai's clearance was sent July 11.
subfiles.title: Letter from John M. Allison to Claude A. Buss confirming clearance for Kazuo Kawai
